text:
marie (Partnerships): Quick QA request 1 - AuroraGrid one-pager + marketplace tile uploaded to Figma. Need logo lockup check, hero alt text, and accessibility-friendly CTA variants. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/AuroraGrid-Redwood-Partnership
rafael (Design): Opening it. The AuroraGrid mark overlaps our footer safezone on mobile breakpoint. We should bump it left 12px and use the stacked lockup for narrow sizes.
claire (PMM): For the marketplace tile, they asked for a 16:9 hero and a 1:1 thumbnail. Which CTA do we lead with? 'Explore integration' or 'Deploy AuroraGrid'?
marie (Partnerships): Marketplace wants partner-led CTAs. Recommend 'Deploy AuroraGrid' for the store tile and 'Explore integration' on the joint landing.
yun (Localization): Will provide CTA translations. Note: Korean market prefers verbs first; I'll send localized orderings.
nana -> ana (Legal): FYI we need the partner's trademark descriptor line and a signed marketing consent before publish. Also verify any benchmarking claims.
nana (typo ignore)
rafael (Design): Uploaded a mobile frame with stacked lockup and updated spacing tokens. Also added two alt text options per image: short and long.
claire (PMM): There's a performance callout 'reduces latency by 35%'. Do we have an attribution? We should add 'based on AuroraGrid internal tests' or link to docs.
nana -> ana (Legal): Please include the dataset/environment for the benchmark or soften the language to 'observed improvements in internal tests'.
marie (Partnerships): Action list: 1) @rafael adjust hero safezone and export 1:1 thumbnail at 1200px, 2) @ana request signed marketing consent and trademark line, 3) @yun provide localized CTAs (KR, JP, ES, FR), 4) @claire confirm benchmark attribution or change copy.
asset-bot: Checklist update: missing signed consent, marketplace thumbnail file, and alt-text finalization. Deadline: 4 business days.
marketplace-bot: Reminder from Marketplace: thumbnails must be legible at 80px. Consider a badge-only variant.
rafael (Design): Tested badge-only at 80px 1 - legible but tight. I'll create a simplified glyph variant for the badge.
yun (Localization): Sending CTA strings in thread: KR: '배포하기', JP: 'デプロイ', ES: 'Implementar AuroraGrid', FR: 'Déployer AuroraGrid'. Let me know if we prefer shorter forms.
claire (PMM): Thanks Yun. For EN canonical CTA we'll use 'Deploy AuroraGrid'. For landing header change 'faster inference' to 'lower-latency inference' to be precise.
nana -> ana (Legal): I'll request consent and ask for a logo usage addendum. Also requesting the benchmark test script for review.
marie (Partnerships): Great. I'll ping AuroraGrid PM for sign-off and update the tracker. Closing note: please attach final exported PNGs and a README.txt with alt text variants before handoff.
